categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determination for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, locations, ownership details (all owned by "The State"), and land classifications. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements for multiple land parcels in the Kurunegala District.
